name: LEGO Ninjago Tournament Vita
author: 1theronin
description:
LEGO Ninjago Tournament is an action fighting game featuring the ninja heroes and villains of LEGO NINJAGO. Players choose from a roster of characters, train in the Dojo and battle through a series of tournament arenas, using attacks, blocks, dashes and Spinjitzu to defeat opponents and unlock new fighters.
This is a port of the Android version (1.04.1) to the PS Vita, made with a .so loader that runs the original game code natively. It includes sound effects and music, support for the Vita's physical buttons and analog stick, rendering of the 3D scenes at the full 960x544 resolution, and a shader cache that shortens loading times after the first start.
requirements:
- libshacccg.suprx
- kubridge.skprx
- Game Data Files: Android
